en: Multiview color postcard showing several medieval painted churches and monasteries of Bucovina in Suceava County, Romania. Panels depict Moldovița, Humor, Voroneț (center roundel with blue exterior frescoes), Putna church, Dragomirna, Arbore, Sucevița and Bogdan-Vodă. A yellow caption block reads "MONUMENTE ISTORICE ȘI DE ARTĂ din județul SUCEAVA." The reverse says CARTE POȘTALĂ, lists the monuments with their centuries, and shows the publisher Editura Meridiane and price Lei 3.
